title: EC60078: Nonlinear Optics
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Pre-requisites: NoneGeneral theory of nonlinear optics, characterization of
nonlinear medium, connection with electro-optic coefficients, optics of
crystal, principal axes, dispersive medium, second order process, Manley-Rowe
relations, parametric oscillations, second harmonic generation, Kerr effect
third order process, magneto-optics, quarter wave and half wave plates,
nonlinear phenomena in guided wave, solitons, effect of chirping in soliton
propagation in fibre, nonlinear effects in semiconductors, lasers, optical
bistability, devices based on nonlinear property.
